Closed comedones extraction ✨ These tiny flesh-coloured bumps are caused by clogged pores, excess oil, dead skin build-up, and congestion trapped underneath the skin. Unlike blackheads, closed comedones stay covered by skin, which is why they can create uneven texture and stubborn bumps. During this treatment, we carefully extract the congestion while helping to deeply cleanse and smooth the skin for a clearer, healthier complexion. For best long-term results, a course of treatments combined with the correct skincare routine is usually recommended to prevent the congestion from returning. #ClosedComedones #ExtractionFacial #SkinCare #DeepCleansing #AcneTreatment

dermatologist rates viral skincare trends 👀 #drybrushing #sunburn #fyp    dry brushing (2/10): damages the skin barrier and can cause irritation and tears. use a gentle chemical exfoliant instead putting diaper cream on your face (10/10): applying a zinc oxide based diaper rash cream on your face at night is derm approved to help heal irritation and a damaged skin barrier. photo cred: katavibez lint roller to remove sunburn (0/10): just no! if you burn and are peeling, do not peel off the skin, it acts as a natural dressing to help the burn heal faster. cool showers and aloe gel are your friend. photo cred: sawaduffs hemorrhoid cream for dark circles (4/10): hemorrhoid creams have ingredients that can constrict blood vessels which may help with puffy eye bags, but some contain steroids which thin undereye skin and make dark circles worse! try a caffeine eye cream instead or for pigmented dark circles, use thiamidol (Eucerin radiant tone)  LED masks (8/10): love them as an at-home treatment/self-care step to maximize results from your  skincare routine but it's important to pick a device with adequate energy pimple patches for bug bites (9/10): pimple patches are essentially hydrocolloid bandages. You can buy hydrocolloid bandaids and cut them to size to help them heal bug bites (and prevent scratching) and blisters. photo cred: angelicagervais Gua sha (6/10): can promote circulation and temporarily reduce puffiness, but unlikely to change facial shape/structure panoxyl for body odor (20/10): use panoxyl 4% in the shower on your arm pits a few times per week and reduce odor causing bacteria. it can stain towels and sheets though!  azelaic acid + tretinoin (100/10): derm-loved actives that work together to combat dark spots, acne and improve skin texture and glow. avoid tretinoin in pregnancy  barrier repair creams (infinity/10): barrier repair creams can soothe irritation and  flaky patches, and heal a damaged skin barrier overnight! works for almost all skin types  #CapCut

finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
